title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defies a Passport Order and Lands in Miami
dek: Brazil's defeated candidate crossed into Argentina and flew via Ecuador to Florida after the State Department granted his family visas. He has not been charged.
body: Ordered to hand over his passports, he crossed into Argentina, flew via Guayaquil and landed at Opa-locka on 28 October.

panels.label: Bolsonaro's Allies Say
panels.text: Allies say he left “to continue the fight against tyranny” and would otherwise be “a political prisoner”; his camp calls the case political.

panels.label: Brazilian Officials Say
panels.text: Brazilian officials warned Washington not to accept him, a State Department official told the Post; police cancelled his passports.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: His allies speak of “tyranny,” the court of a money-laundering probe; beneath both is whether Brazil can try him at all.
